source.title: Eye-Tracking Analysis of Visual Attention and Preference in Human-Created, AI-Generated, and AI-Refined Human Advertisements

finding: Participants selected fully AI-generated ads in approximately 59% of trials that paired them with human-created ads.
locator: Results, Human vs. AI forced-choice comparison
limitation: The study measured preference between specific ads in a forced-choice task. It did not measure outfit recognition, purchases, or response among UK apparel shoppers.
audience: Young adults aged 18–26 with generative AI experience
